alex: hi everyone, onboarding question: I need access to AWS Dedicated account and the GCP project 'redwood-private-eu' (mostly europe-west1). Who should I ping for billing and region quotas?

marta: welcome! For AWS we use AWS SSO -> permission set 'DedicatedAccess'. Ping @infra to attach it. For GCP billing, Finance handles the Billing Account Viewer.

alex: thanks. do I need any special IAM for GPUs in eu-west1? we run a lot of inference there.

cloud-sre: GCP IAM is project/org-level. For GPUs you may need quota increases per region. Submit a quota request in Google Cloud Console and cc @cloud-sre so we can accelerate. Also request 'roles/iam.serviceAccountUser' on platform-deploy SA if you'll deploy jobs.

infra-bot: INF-524 created: "SSO + GCP access for alex". Assigned to infra. ETA 1 business day.

marta: one more note: we require 2FA + security key before granting cross-account roles. If you haven't enrolled, visit https://go.redwood.internal/security/2fa to register your key.

alex: enrolled 2fa now, filing billing ticket. thanks all!
